paragraphs: Rav Abba (or Rabbah) bar Shumani: Eruvin 64a.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman explicitly gives Rav Abba or Rabbah bar Shumani. The saved Davidson Eruvin64a scalar has Rabbi Abba bar Shumni. Source Rav and the alternative Rabbah remain rather than being replaced by that digital witness; Shumani/Shumni are transliteration differences, not identity decisions. Full Rav is explicit before Abba; the parenthetical Rabbah has no separately supplied title.
